hypothesis: Contradictory parse/abstention metadata, dropped source digit/identifier literals and invalid gold outside a pilot's selected prefix must be rejected before provider discovery or generation.
visionGuardrails: Source and historical evidence remain unchanged.
No semantic schema, vocabulary, identity or parser-prompt changes.
Mechanical gold consistency is necessary, not human meaning adjudication.
hardGates: Every full-corpus gold row receives metadata and semantic preflight.
A parse target cannot have null gold; an abstention target must explicitly have null gold.
Unknown outcomes/languages, missing source metadata and duplicate IDs fail before any provider call.
Gold must meet the same necessary digit/identifier retention floor as extracted candidates.
Permanent regression tests catch deliberate guard removal.
nonClaims: No source-understanding accuracy or native/human qualification.
No historical corpus is repaired or re-scored as protected evidence.
